how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:engineering-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1559:completion:0: So you're an engineer, eh? Well, for your help in getting me those pearls, here's the recipe for flash bombs. ⟦1⟧ Good luck, and try not to blind yourself!
rows.quest:3526:obj:0: If you wish to learn more about ⟦E1⟧, take the ⟦E2⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:3526:details:0: Expert engineering yields two distinct disciplines: gnome and goblin. Clearly, goblin engineering is the choice of all brilliant engineers. Learn to master the world through the judicious use of high explosives and fantastic gear!
rows.quest:3526:details:1: B⟦2⟧, read this manual. If you want to learn about goblin engineering, then take it to ⟦E3⟧ in Gadgetzan. Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure this is what you want before finishing his task.
rows.quest:3526:progress:0: I can smell fresh recruits much like I can an excellent blasting powder - from a mile away. Have you come seeking to learn about the mastery of the explosion?
rows.quest:3526:completion:0: Well ⟦3⟧, you were wise to seek my tutelage! Any schlep can become an expert at the basics of engineering - the gnomes and their irradiated home of ⟦E4⟧ are proof of that. It takes a strong mind and a steady hand (emphasis on STEADY) though to master the discipline of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:3526:completion:1: Keep your ears perked ⟦4⟧, and you might learn something.

rows.quest:3638:obj:0: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with ⟦E3⟧ in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:3638:details:0: Goblin engineering is about practical uses for high profit and higher explosive power! Our schemata allow us to make powerful bombs and mighty weaponry; the manual you read covered this.
rows.quest:3638:details:1: The manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. Once you become a goblin engineer, that's that. There is no access to ⟦E12⟧ at all.
rows.quest:3638:details:2: If you still want to become a goblin engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again. Think about it carefully, ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:3638:progress:0: If you've signed the document and are ready to hand it to me, then that is that. You've been told that this is a one way trip. If you're ready, then hop on board!
rows.quest:3638:completion:0: Welcome aboard, Goblin Engineer ⟦17⟧! You soon will have access to the most powerful engineering schemata anywhere on ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:3638:completion:1: Now that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your goblin-oriented engineering work. From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your goblin engineering talents!

I need the following: twenty big iron bombs, twenty sticks of solid dynamite, and five explosive sheep - and keep the safeties armed!
rows.quest:3639:details:1: Submit these items to me and I will issue you your own ⟦E19⟧; it is required for access to all goblin engineering trainers!
rows.quest:3639:progress:0: Once I receive your crafted engineering items for my review, I will hand you a genuine ⟦E19⟧! So long as the card is valid, you will have unlimited access to any goblin engineer trainer anywhere in the world.
rows.quest:3639:completion:1: This card has its dues paid for in advance for fourteen days; all cards expire after two weeks of activity. rows.quest:3639:completion:2: This never affects what you already know; once a goblin engineer, always a goblin engineer.
